description: Worked example (D-14): the count-from-prior chunk shape. A u32 'recordCount' field is followed by N records of { u16 id, f32 weight }. The array's repeat kind is CountFromField bound to recordCount, so on encode the count is AUTO-RECOMPUTED from the live element count (D-10) and a grow/shrink edit round-trips byte-exact (the DEC-C3 gate). This is the teaching template for any count-then-N-records leaf. matchTagOnly so it engages on the CNTR leaf at every version-FORM.
